movelist.name: Sand Attack
movelist.effect: The target is Blinded until the end of their next turn.

movelist.name: Mud-Slap
movelist.effect: The target’s Accuracy is lowered by -1.

movelist.name: Magnitude
movelist.effect: When you use Magnitude, roll 1d6.  Magnitude’s Damage Base is equal to 5+X, where X is the value of the d6. Magnitude can hit targets that are underground, including those using the Move Dig.

movelist.name: Bulldoze
movelist.effect: All Legal Targets are lowered 1 Speed Combat Stage.

movelist.name: Growl
movelist.effect: Growl lowers all Legal Targets Attack 1 Combat Stage.

abilities.name: Arena Trap
abilities.effect: Once Arena Trap is activated, all foes within 5 meters of the user are considered Slowed and Trapped. This does not affect targets of the Flying Type, or with a Levitate, Sky, or Burrow Speed of 4 or higher. The user may end the effect as a Free Action, and the effect ends if the user is Fainted or returned to a Poké Ball.

abilities.name: Celebrate
abilities.effect: The user may immediately Disengage as a Free Action.
